Role Title: Food Delivery AI Response Evaluator

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Food Delivery AI Response Evaluators to contribute to a client’s innovative project focused on enhancing AI-driven customer interactions within the food delivery sector. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work:

  1. Assess and provide feedback on AI-generated responses within food delivery platforms for quality, relevance, and accuracy.
  2. Identify nuances in written and verbal communication to ensure AI outputs align with realistic and effective customer service standards.
  3. Review context-specific scenarios, such as order inquiries, delivery status updates, and issue resolution exchanges.
  4. Flag incorrect, ambiguous, or inappropriate responses, offering concise suggestions for improvement.
  5. Create illustrative example conversations that reflect authentic food delivery customer interactions.
  6. Collaborate with project leads and technical teams to clarify requirements and optimize evaluation processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Demonstrated expertise in food delivery, hospitality, customer service, or related sectors.
  2. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a strong attention to detail.
  3. Experience evaluating communications or providing feedback in service-oriented environments.
  4. Comfort working independently and adhering to project guidelines.
  5. Familiarity with digital delivery platforms, apps, or AI-driven tools is advantageous.
  6. Ability to offer constructive analysis and articulate improvement suggestions clearly.
  7. Adaptability to shifting project priorities and willingness to engage with diverse tasks.
